name: @shizue/plot
//scripts: No `build` here on purpose. This manifest is a workspace package like any other now, so the workspace root's `pnpm -r build` already builds `packages/*` and `apps/*` in topological order — a `pnpm -r build` here would recurse into itself, and a filtered one would build the same tree a second time, `next build` included. Build plot from the root: `pnpm --filter './apps/plot/**' build`.
